newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Orange County, Fla..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Orange County, Fla..

text.p: The School District of Orange County

Sealed bids will be received by The School District of Orange County, Florida (the District'') at the office of the Assistant Superintendent for Business Services at the Educational Leadership Center, 445 West Amelia Street, Orlando, FL., for the purchase of the above-referenced Notes, subject to the provisions of the Official Notice of Sale, until 11:00 a.m., EST on

or such other date (which later date shall not be earlier than ten (10) days nor later than sixty days from the date of publication hereof) to be communicated through Munifacts News Service at least twenty-four (24) hours prior to such alternate sale date. The Notes will be dated November 13, 1996 (the anticipated date of delivery) and will mature on September 15,1997. Interest is payable upon maturity of the Notes based on a 360 day year. The Notes are not subject to redemption prior to their stated maturity. The Notes will be issued in book- entry-only form through DTC.

The Notes and the interest thereon are secured by and payable from certain ad valorem taxes of the District received solely for operating purposes during its fiscal year ending June 30, 1997, all as more fully described in the Preliminary Official Statement.
The Notes have been rated MIG-1'' by Moody's Investors Service.

Bids may be submitted only on the Official Bid Form attached to the Official Notice of Sale. Copies of the Official Notice of Sale, the Preliminary Official Statement and Official Bid Form may be obtained from the District's financial advisor, Government Financial Advisors, Inc., 174 W. Comstock Avenue, Suite 220, Winter Park, Florida 32789, telephone (407) 740-8383.
By s/ Dr. Donald Shaw, Superintendent
